hints.title: Monotonic Work Feasibility
hints.text: If all workers can reduce the mountain to height 0 within T seconds, they can also do so in any time greater than T.

hints.title: Quadratic Work Closed Form
hints.text: A worker with base speed t can reduce x height units in t * x * (x + 1) / 2 seconds. Given T seconds, solve the quadratic inequality to find maximum x = floor((-1 + sqrt(1 + 8T/t)) / 2).

hints.title: Binary Search Bound
hints.text: Set search range between 1 and min(workerTimes) * mountainHeight * (mountainHeight + 1) / 2. In each iteration, sum x across all workers and adjust binary search boundaries.

hints.title: Reference Implementation
hints.text:
```python
class Solution:
    def minNumberOfSeconds(self, mountainHeight: int, workerTimes: list[int]) -> int:
        import math
        
        def check(seconds: int) -> bool:
            total_height = 0
            for t in workerTimes:
                # t * x * (x + 1) / 2 <= seconds
                # x * (x + 1) <= 2 * seconds / t
                # x^2 + x - 2 * seconds / t <= 0
                val = (2 * seconds) // t
                x = int((-1 + math.isqrt(1 + 4 * val)) // 2)
                total_height += x
                if total_height >= mountainHeight:
                    return True
            return False
            
        low = 1
        # Upper bound: fastest worker does all work
        min_w = min(workerTimes)
        high = min_w * mountainHeight * (mountainHeight + 1) // 2
        ans = high
        
        while low <= high:
            mid = (low + high) // 2
            if check(mid):
                ans = mid
                high = mid - 1
            else:
                low = mid + 1
                
        return ans
```

complexity.notes: Each binary search step evaluates W workers in O(1) time using closed-form square roots.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Simulating second-by-second reductions or min-heap simulation takes too long for large mountain heights.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: O(1) auxiliary space without extra arrays.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Formulates binary search on answer using quadratic root formula for individual worker reduction.
